The rule will target people with no shifts in the previous 60 days, set their membership inactive to revoke training access, and remove them from the reminder list to stop shift emails on every roster refresh.
A.final_response: If a person has had no shifts in 60 days, then remove them from shift reminders while keeping their membership and training access unchanged.

A.first_response:

```text
completed = intake_survey_complete AND session_complete
ready_for_payment = completed
```

A participant enters the payment queue only after completing both the intake survey and the session.
A.final_response:

```text
completed = session_attended
eligible_for_payment = completed
```

The intake survey does not affect payment eligibility.
